title: Food for Everyone
text:
Many people in our city do not have enough food. A small shop near my house gives free bread every evening. Some volunteers work there on Tuesdays and Fridays. They help people from many different countries.

Some people think the shop should be bigger. Others believe the city government should help more. The shop manager says that the most important thing is to help people today.

questions.text: Who works at the shop on Tuesdays and Fridays?
What do some people think about the shop?
Why does the shop give free bread?
options: Because it wants to make more money
Because many people need help with food
Because it is a new shop

questions.text: What is the shop manager's main opinion?
options: Helping people now is the most important thing
The city should do everything alone

vocabulary.definition: people who help others without being paid
the group of people who run a country or city
a person who is in charge of a shop or business

paragraph_translations: Wielu ludzi w naszym mieście nie ma wystarczająco dużo jedzenia. Mały sklep blisko mojego domu rozdaje bezpłatny chleb każdego wieczoru. Niektórzy wolontariusze pracują tam we wtorki i piątki. Pomagają ludziom z wielu różnych krajów.
Niektórzy uważają, że sklep powinien być większy. Inni uważają, że rząd miasta powinien bardziej pomagać. Kierownik sklepu mówi, że najważniejsze jest pomagać ludziom dzisiaj.
